description: This source file implements classes related to stream namespace predicate providers in the Orleans streaming infrastructure, including default and constructor-based providers.

classes.name: DefaultStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides default stream namespace predicates for '*', regex patterns, and exact match based predicates.

classes.name: ConstructorStreamNamespacePredicateProvider
classes.description: Provides stream namespace predicates that are constructed dynamically based on type names and optional constructor arguments.

methods.name: TryGetPredicate
methods.description: Attempts to parse a predicate pattern string and returns an appropriate IStreamNamespacePredicate object.

methods.name: FormatPattern
methods.description: Formats a predicate pattern string for a given predicate type and an optional constructor argument.
